title: Canonical orbit data of a finite action
statement: For every finite group action A : G →* Equiv.Perm (Fin d), there exists D : FixedOrbitData G d with D.action = A.

proof.text: Pull the permutation action back to a Mathlib MulAction. Use MulAction.orbitRel, the finite quotient Q and Fintype.equivFin Q to index quotient representatives chosen by Quotient.out. Quotient.out_eq proves completeness and distinctness. Use Mathlib MulAction.stabilizer for each representative; its membership condition is definitionally the required specification.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof using Mathlib orbit quotients and stabilizers, with no postponed theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: finite group action orbit representatives stabilizer

lean.statement:
theorem fixedOrbitData_of_action
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G] (d : ℕ) (A : G →* Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    ∃ D : FixedOrbitData G d, D.action = A
